task: Review this fictional stage sketch in about 70–110 words for a performer and director. The brief allows one actor, one chair, one folded cloth, and no spoken or recorded words. Identify the gap between private backstory and what an audience can perceive. You may propose a small playable action using the permitted materials, clearly as a suggestion rather than an established event.
input: She sits on the only chair, with the folded cloth on her knee. Without moving, she remembers a promise made in another town ten years ago. The audience understands the exact terms of the promise. She stays silent, while an unheard explanation makes everything clear.
